sources.note: Shure PSM 300 spec sheet (read as text on 2026-11-12): P3T half-rack transmitter 43 x 198 x 172 mm (H x W x D), 783 g, 12-15 V DC external supply; rear-panel balanced inputs and loop outputs on 6.35 mm (1/4 in) TRS, a detachable antenna, front-panel controls with an input level knob and a one-touch sync. The sheet gives the connector types and the rear panel, not the count: two inputs and two loop outputs (the stereo L and R pair) follow the knowledge base (P3T audio inputs and loop outputs, 2 each), so portsDocumented is set. The antenna (BNC) and DC input have no catalogue signal type and are drawn on the picture only (no port). The P3R body-pack in the same record is a separate device. Port and control positions are GUESSES (no panel drawing read).
Shure PSM 300 user guide as listed by the knowledge base (the page returned navigation only when opened in this run).

Mains (review fix, read 2026-11-12 by a research pass): the PSM 300 guide says the P3T transmitter has a Power Input jack fed by the external PS24 supply and no IEC inlet. No mains inlet is modelled for this device and the entry says so.
